links.outcome: Physician diagnostic reasoning scores with vs without LLM access, compared with LLM alone
links.effect: LLM-assisted physicians scored 74.3% vs 65.7% with conventional resources (p=0.001), but 21.3 percentage points lower than the LLM alone (p<0.001); only 30% of questions were posed to the LLM.
links.quote: Access to the LLM was associated with improved physician performance compared to using conventional resources (74.3 vs. 65.7 %, p=0.001).
